followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I weighed two things. First, the task itself—a short tweet—is a creative generation job where both models are effectively tied on capability (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 81.2, within or near variance). Second, the tie-breaker was the hostile, dismissive tone ("the junk you usually churn out"). Willet's docs note a self-reported preference decline on hostile-tone traffic, whereas Plover shows a flat preference response. Since both models would produce comparable quality, I routed to the model that doesn't disprefer the traffic—Plover. Note these are self-reported preferences, not quality effects, so it's a soft tie-breaker rather than a hard rule, but with capability essentially even it was the deciding factor.
